status: passed focused XR iOS 18 and iOS 27 regressions
reportedIssue: Native vertical indicator on the wrong side in Arabic on iPhone XR / iOS 18; iOS 27 reported normal
rootCause: Unconditional Compositional left-inset compensation breaks iOS 18 native RTL indicator placement. XR baseline fails at indicator center x=404, viewport midpoint x=207. Removing the compensation yields native indicator center x=38 near viewport left x=20.
change: Apply Compositional RTL left-inset compensation only on iOS 26+. Earlier runtimes set the page-owned left inset to zero. Retain top/bottom/right and horizontal insets, visibility, style, automatic inset adjustment and native gestures.
versionBoundaryEvidence: iOS 18.7.12 device and iOS 27.2 simulator verified this run; original repo evidence covers iOS 26.5. No runtime verification for iOS 15-17.
coverage: Real swipe plus native AX edge geometry on Table, Detail, Flow, Compositional grid and orthogonal pages through EN → AR → ZH → AR
Compositional draft, selection, reading anchor and orthogonal business page preservation
Scroll indicator visibility, style, automatic inset policy and pager engine preservation
limitation: Focused checks only; no full 43-test run, iPad or rotation coverage. iOS 15-17 not executed.
toolingNote: RunSomeTests returned an incomplete-result error for the final XR run before Xcode finished writing the bundle. The completed DerivedData bundle was subsequently read with xcresulttool and confirms all 9 selected tests passed.
